svg.aria-label: Five recurring serving optimization patterns across 11 merged SGLang-Omni PRs
svg.text: ELEVEN MERGED PRS · FIVE RECURRING PATTERNS
What coding agents actually changed inside the SGLang-Omni runtime
Idle threads compete for CPU cores
Spinning wait-loops hold physical cores the pipeline needs; letting
idle encoder threads sleep frees all cores at once.
Data is converted at every stage hop
Features crossed stage boundaries as Python lists; keeping tensors
Skips unused quantizer reconstructions, duplicate fallback
frontends, excess fbank frames & repeated ref-audio encoding.
Too many small GPU kernel launches
Replaces CPU-bound per-kernel launch gaps with full-step CUDA Graph
Prefill and decode took turns idling; async prefill overlaps request
k+1 prefill with request k decode.
